mapper.select: SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_code, lc.card_company_code, cc.card_company_name, COALESCE(c.card_name, 'KB국민카드') AS card_name, COALESCE(c.card_img_file_name, 'card_default.png') AS card_img_file_name, c.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code LEFT JOIN card_company_tbl cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.card_company_code INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON lc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN lc.represent_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lc.linked_card_id DESC

SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_code, lc.card_company_code, cc.card_company_name, COALESCE(c.card_name, 'KB국민카드') AS card_name, COALESCE(c.card_img_file_name, 'card_default.png') AS card_img_file_name, c.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code LEFT JOIN card_company_tbl cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.card_company_code INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON lc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.linked_card_id = #{linkedCardId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linked_card_tbl lc WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_code, lc.card_company_code, COALESCE(c.card_name, 'KB국민카드') AS card_name, COALESCE(c.card_img_file_name, 'card_default.png') AS card_img_file_name, c.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.linked_card_id != #{linkedCardId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY lc.linked_card_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_tbl ( card_num, expiry_date, cvv, card_password, card_img_file_name, card_name ) VALUES ( #{cardNum}, #{expiryDate}, #{cvv}, #{cardPassword}, #{cardImgFileName}, #{cardName} )
mapper.select: SELECT card_name AS cardName, card_img_file_name AS imageUrl FROM card_tbl WHERE card_num LIKE CONCAT(#{bin}, '%') LIMIT 1
